description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from career success, gain negative Moodlets from career failure, and may become Tense if not promoted.
These Sims tend to be Happier than other Sims.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from watching the Kids Network, become Playful when playing with Children, and become Happy when playing with Children's toys.
These Sims tend to fail more often at physical activities and tend to laugh at failure instead of becoming upset.
These Sims tend to be Inspired, can Share Creative Ideas with other Sims, and may become upset if they're not creative for a period of time.
These Sims can Talk to themselves and have unpredictable Emotions.
These Sims tend to be Focused, can Share Ideas with other Sims, and may become upset if they haven't improved their Mental Skills for some time.
These Sims tend to be Sad, can Share Melancholy Thoughts to other Sims, and while sad, gain a boost to their Creative Skill.
These Sims tend to be Playful.

These Sims are driven by strong emotions, whose honesty reveal internal conflicts. They quickly form bonds with Loyal and similar Sims, but develop negative relationships faster with Mean or Evil Sims.

These Sims require extra work to keep in good condition. Their problems sometimes appear trivial, and may even appear out of the blue. These struggles can be remedied through mindful habits, which puts them in a state of catharsis.
These Sims tend to be Angry, can Rile up other Sims, and become Angry when targeted with Mischief.
Sims with this trait are constantly swept up in the whirlwind of romance. They fall in love easily, often wearing their hearts on their sleeves..
Paranoid Sims feel that danger is around every corner, and that people are always talking about them. Paranoid Sims feel a sense of security while hanging out in basements.
Sims with this trait learn skills faster, even if they are a bit slower at first.
These Sims tend to be Flirty and may become Sad if they don't have any Romantic social interactions for a period of time.
These Sims often tread carefully in the realm of love, preferring to take their time and build solid emotional connections before jumping headfirst into romance.
These Sims tend to be Confident.
Squeamish Sims are nauseated by the sight of creepy crawlies, vomiting, violence and death. These Sims become Uncomfortable near anything dirty.
These Sims get Tense around Flirty Sims and seldom get Flirty themselves. It's difficult for them to be Romantic in public.

A Sim who's experienced enough of life to know what really matters. These Sims enjoy reminiscing and sharing life's wisdom, making them excellent Mentors for those willing to listen. Their years of experience allow them to naturally learn new Skills with ease, and their emotional intelligence reduces their angry and uncomfortable thoughts.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Viewing works of art and can Admire Art and Discuss Art in unique ways.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from reading Books and can Analyze Books and Discuss Books in unique ways.
These Sims can't wait to get down, boogie, and party all night! When at venues like Bars, Nightclubs, and Lounges, these Sims can get a burst of energy with the Party Time interaction.
These Sims become Happy and have Fun when eating good food, become Uncomfortable when eating bad food, and can Watch Cooking Shows for ideas.
These Sims become Happy when Reading Sci-Fi or Playing Video Games, may become Tense if they haven't played much, are better at finding Collectibles, and can Discuss Geek Things with other Geek Sims.
These Sims can Enthuse about Nature to other Sims and become Happy when Outdoors.

These Sims become happy when making things. They become sad when it's been too long since completing a project on a Fabricator, Candlemaking Station, Juice Fizzer, or Woodworking Table. They do not receive negative effects from crafting or repair failures.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets and boost their Fun Need when Listening to Music and become Happy when playing instruments.
These Sims are rabid recyclers that benefit from recycling and rummaging for bits and pieces, but should they go too long without indulging in their hobby...
These Sims tend to be Energized, can Pump Up other Sims, and may become upset if they don't exercise for a period of time.
These Sims gain boosts from imaginative activities gaining creative Skills faster but may get overwhelmed at times.
These Sims seek out new and unique experiences.

Chased by Death sims know that death follows their every move. While risky and dangerous behaviors may have deadly consequences, frequent near-death experiences give these Sims a desire to live each day to the fullest and progress along their soul's journey faster. Keenly aware of theirs own mortality , these Sims feel best when they are achieving something meaningful with their limited time left.

These Sims experience a spiritual connection to islands of Sulani. Honor the islands by partaking in their culture, summon powerful elementals and reap the rewards of their blessings—or the consequences of their disfavor.
Answer the call of the ocean! Sims with this trait will prefer water related activities and feel closer to denizens of the sea.
These Sims love feeling anchored to their community and Tomarani culture. Keeping in touch with loved ones and engaging in activities that remind them of home is important for being Happy.

Competitive Sims have to be the best at anything they put their sweaty focus on, especially games and physical activities. They're all about winning, so they take losing really personally. Depending on how they manage their Competitive Spirit, these Sims can either become an inspiration for Sim excellence or bask in the toxic pits of the abyss and become the ultimate sore loser!

Disruptive Sims are driven to interact with the world by messing with it. They can spread interpersonal chaos by Giving Bad Balance Advice or stick it to nature by Disrupting Plants. Disruptive Sims build Mischief Skill faster but are slower to regain Balance than most Sims.

These Sims reject consumerism and prefer to reduce wasteful spending by any means. They enjoy finding re-used or thrown away goods and foods. In fact, they have the best luck at finding the highest-quality treasures in Dumpsters! They may become tense or uncomfortable if they spend too much time earning or spending Simoleons.
These Sims have a greater negative reaction to Hunger, always enjoy eating, no matter the quality of the food, and will eat Spoiled Food.
These Sims are happiest when living on a green street and will continuously work towards making their environment more eco-friendly.
These Sims don't mind "borrowing" things from others with a simple swipe, but will get Tense when they have not swiped anything in a while.
These Sims will become sick if they eat dairy, but will feel great if they have avoided it for a while.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Watching TV or Napping as well as from Comfortable furniture, become Fatigued more quickly from exercise, and grow Tense when performing household chores.

Embrace your inner darkness - and your occasional intrusions of light. Macabre Sims are all about being their best, unique Sim self while still reveling in all that life (and the afterlife) has to offer.
These Sims can Admire and Brag about Possessions and become Sad when they haven't purchased a new item for a period of time.

Feeling a strong affinity for both the natural and supernatural, Mystical Sims see higher purpose in living harmoniously in each world and sharing that with other Sims. These Sims learn Apothecary and Gardening Skills faster and have an easier time building friendships with Occult Sims. Mystical Sims can offer to Grant a Sacred Blessing to other Sims, which increases Balance for both Sims if accepted.
These Sims become Happy and have Fun when performing household chores, can have a Cleaning Frenzy, and become really Uncomfortable in dirty surroundings.
These Sims tend to raise their skills faster and are happy when they finish work tasks, but are a little harder to get along with as friends.
These Sims take longer to craft items but tend to make them higher quality, gain powerful Moodlets after crafting a high quality item, and gain negative Moodlets after crafting a low quality item.
These Sims excel at ranch life and take pride in their work. They enjoy ranch chores and caring for their Livestock.
Not entirely trusting of the majority of things you see or hear? Skeptical Sims like to challenge the universe to provide concrete proof that something is indeed as it might appear.
These Sims are not affected by dirty surroundings, make household items dirtier faster, and can Rummage for Food in garbage.
These Sims will actively avoid eating foods that contain meat products and can become sick if they eat such foods.
These Sims are obsessed with animals, and will seek their company often. They will have an easier time caring for animals and getting closer to them.
These Sims can Bro Hug other Bros, gain Confidence around other Bros, and become Energized from Watching Sports.
These Sims tend to make cats their companions, preferring the company of cats to other Sims.
Sims who are obnoxiously oblivious and oftentimes met with polarizing reactions. Cringe Sims can be socially unaware of their surroundings at times, but have an adorable enthusiasm for life.
These Sims love to be near dogs. They will gain relationships faster with dogs and socialize with dogs more than the average Sim.
These Sims become Happy around Sims with negative Moodlets, can Laugh Maniacally and Discuss Evil Plans, and become Angry when interacting with Good Sims.
These Sims become Happy around family members, become Sad if they don't interact with family for a period of time, and can Boast about Family.
Caring, empathetic, and patient. These Sims are happiest when offering their time and money to help others. Everyone loves Generous Sims, but they can be a little too brazen with their donations.
These Sims become Happy around Sims with positive Moodlets, can Donate to Charity, become Sad with interacting with Evil Sims, and can Discuss World Peace.
These Sims raise their Mischief skill faster by playing pranks and bothering others with their surprises.
These Sims become Angry around Children, become Tense after Try for a Baby, and can be Mean to Children.
These Sims share a strong bond with Horses. They have an easier time socializing with and caring for Horses than other Sims.
These Sims hold high moral standards and strive for a better world guided by their values and principles. They are committed to doing what they believe is right, even when it's challenging.
These Sims love being in Clubs, and tend to be happiest when surrounded by their friends.
These Sims get Jealous more easily than other Sims. They gain a boost of Confidence from being around their significant other, but get Tense if they haven't seen them recently.
These Sims become Happy when alone, do not receive negative Moodlets when their Social Need is low, become Tense around strangers, and become Embarrassed more often by social rejection.

Loyal sims value their relationships and fully commit to them. whether they are friendship, romance or even work! They avoid lying and cheating because their loved ones' trust is very important to them.
These Sims become Happy when being Mean or Mischievous to other Sims and become Confident after winning a fight.
These Sims become Tense after a while in the same job or relationship, become Happy when they Quit a Job or Break Off a relationship, take longer to Propose, and can Discuss their Fear of Commitment.
Sims who thrive on gossip, snooping, and spying. They have incredibly poor boundaries and don't quite understand what personal space is, but they will discover secrets by any means necessary.
These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Friendly socialization, have their Social need decay quickly, and gain more negative Moodlets when their Social need is low.
These Sims tend to enjoy parties and letting every other Sim know by hyping up a crowd and performing party tricks.

Plant Lover Sims treat each and every plant like the little Sim they are. Being a friend to plants is not always easy on a Plant Lover's emotions, but luckily these Sims don't need any skill to share their special interest, just a big heart!

These Sims tend to disapprove of other Sims' improper behavior such as Mean or Mischievous socials, but find themselves happier in Formal Outfits and have a much easier time with Friendly and Romantic socials.

These Sims are all about themselves! They can Fish for Compliments, are more excited when receiving a present, and may become tense when they haven’t gotten enough attention. The celebrity spotlight is something they generally relish. After all, everyone else should love them as much as they do themselves, right?

These Sims excel at exploiting situations and bending rules for personal gain, often without regard for conventional ethics or fairness. They thrive in mischievous activities and can influence others to adopt their way of living.
These Sims can Critique Work on low quality items, are bored by "low brow" television, and gain Confidence around other Snob Sims.

These Sims tend to struggle in social situations and build charisma more slowly, but gain powerful Moodlets and Sentiments when they are able to overcome their awkwardness and accompanying nervousness to form close relationships.
Idyllic, easygoing Toddlers. They are never defiant and they don't throw a tantrum. They can easily talk to strangers.
These Toddlers love to socialize. They earn Communication skill faster, and don't suffer Stranger Danger from strangers. They can Share the Love with other Sims.
These shy Toddlers avoid Sims outside the household and get sad if left behind. They gain extra skill when taught. And they recover faster from bad moods when Comforted.
Tiny trouble-makers who love to Cry, cause trouble, and Throw Fits. But being noticed makes them Happy and helps them overcome negative Moodlets.
These Toddlers love their freedom, and don't like to take orders from caregivers. They gain extra skill when they are left alone, and need less Attention than other Toddlers.
Curious explorers. These Toddlers gain Thinking skill slightly faster. They are happiest when learning something, and sad if they haven't learned anything lately.
Goofy and curious. These Toddlers love to tell jokes and get Playful. They earn Imagination skill slightly faster.
Spirited and full of Energy. These Toddlers love to explore and get Energized. They earn Movement skill slightly faster. They get sad if they haven't been outside in a while.
These Sims appreciate the familiar but are slow to warm up to new experiences, locations, and Sims.

These Sims are prone to diaper rash, are often picky with food, and can more easily become overstimulated by too much play and social interaction; however, they also rest more peacefully through the night when soothed.

These Sims like to watch the world, are less likely to cry or become angry, and don't grow tired of activities as easily as other infants; however, they are less likely to explore the world on their own.
These Sims have big emotions and are easily entertained, but they are also more difficult to calm when in a bad mood.
These Sims are always on the go and want to play and move about; however they often struggle to fall asleep or pay attention for extended periods of time.
These Sims are bursting with smiles and giggles and enjoy engaging with other Sims, but they do require more social attention.
Relationships with animals begin at higher values.
It is easier to stay fit and trim when you have High Metabolism.
Musers get better boosts to their skills when they are inspired.
Dastardly Sims perform stronger and more successful mean interactions.
These Sims seem to leave a big impact! Relationship fluctuations are bigger when socializing with Fairy Sims and Gnomes—for better or worse.
Domestic Sims will see their familiar relationships grow stronger faster.
Sims with Essence of Flavor make higher quality food and drink.
Business Savvy Sims earn more money from their careers.
Quick Learners build all skills a little bit faster!
These Sims become Happy when they are in their home neighbourhood.
pack: City Living; Island Living; Snowy Escape; For Rent; StrangerVille; Bust the Dust Kit

description: Alluring Sims are more successful at romance than others.
Collectors can find rare collectibles more often!
Gregarious Sims build friendly relationships faster.
Sims who are Prepared Voyagers fill up their needs slightly when travelling.
Relatable Sims build friendly relationships with fellow teens faster.
Career-Minded Sims get a leg-up in their chosen profession with performance boosts that help them get promoted faster.

These Sims somehow came into possession of Spa Membership. Nobody is really sure where it came from, how to cancel it, or who keeps paying for it each month. But one thing is for certain all fees at Spas are waived! Nice!
These Sims get an initial relationship boost when introducing themselves to werewolves (positive or negative, depending on how they act!)
This Sim is the neighborhood Eco Master! They can inspire other Sims to be eco-conscious.
This Sim is the Neighborhood Entrereneur! They like to take chances with investments and will not refuse handouts.
This Sim is the neighborhood Master Crafter! They can inspire Fabrication recipes in other Sims.
This Sim has been consumed by the Mother Plant and will forever reap her benefits of zero Need Decay
This Sim died of apoplexy, and their rage is still with them.
Death came for (Sim Name) in the form of a well-mixed bug drink. (Sim Name) can relax in a haunted house.

trait: Death By Being Crushed By a Murphy Bed
description: This Sim has found death via a vengeful Murphy Bed.

trait: Death By Being Swarmed By Flies
description: This Sim has found death via an angry swarm of Flies.
This Sim was eaten by a Cow Plant, and still feels a bit oddly towards plants.
Curiosity clocked out! This Sim met their end tinkering with a troublesome cuckoo clock.
This Sim drowned in a body of water and now has a fear of all water.
This Sim was shocked when they suffered a fatal electrocution.
This Sim was mortified, and died of embarrassment. Literally.
This Sim has found death via a fall from heights.
This Sim died in a fire, and flames haunt them still.
Death came for (Sim Name) in the form of a Death Scented Flower Arrangement. (Sim Name) couldn't say no to a gift and paid the price.
This Sim died from excessive exposure to freezing temperatures.
This Sim experienced the chaos that love can bring and died from a broken heart.
This Sim starved to death, and hunger pains have followed them into the afterlife.
Consider this the price paid for being nasty to a chicken.
This Sim provoked a killer rabbit and paid the ultimate price.
This Sim died from a fit of the giggles that continues to pop up now and then.
This Sim was struck by lightning one time too many.
This Sim was struck by a newly discovered rogue meteorite, which resulted in much scientific excitement and a small case of death.
This Sim is the embodiment, or rather "disembodiment" of fungi after succumbing to mold. Some say they've absorbed moldy powers, but will they use it for good?
This Sim died when their time was up.
Apparently it is possible to overdo it. This Sim did it to death.
This Sim died from prolonged exposure to high temperatures.
This Sim died as a result of being poisoned.
This Sim took their life in their mouth and ate a highly toxic fish.
This Sim succumbed to Rabid Rodent Fever, and spreads fear of pestilence and disease in the afterlife.
Overload ghosts are valid targets for Magical interactions including duels, training, and more.
This Sim died from excessive steam exposure and is constantly hot and dehydrated.
(Sim name) died in a Stink Capsule explosion. The fumes from the Stink Capsule were just too much for (Sim name). What a smelly way to go.
This Sim died from over-exposure to those harmful UV rays!
(Sim name) died from an Urban Myth. (Sim name) did not believe in the rumors and paid the ultimate price. Everyone assumes (Sim name) died from fear, but only (Sim name) knows the truth.
This Sim couldn't handle the crushing force of the vending machine and died as a result.
The pursuit of immortality is full of failures and accidents. Luckily, it looks like this will pass in a while. Try to enjoy your phantasmal existence while you can.
This Sim chose to tangle with the talons of the Crow Collective and came out a little less alive as a result.
This Sim emotionally starved to death, and the emotional pangs have followed into the afterlife.
As a Child, this Sim was very active! and challenged themselves to do different athletic activities! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Athlete Career.
As a Child, this Sim was sort of...annoying. They sure did love a good prank! But hey, they had fun. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Mischief Skill.
As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time reading and writing. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Writing Career.
As a Child, this Sim aspired to become famous and tried to make it happen! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Actor Career and gain an extra Fame Point. (Get Famous)
As a Child, this Sim showed a flair for politics and got really good at organizing, persuading, and dreaming of a better future. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Politician Career.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to be a little Business Sim, and they did it! They sold things, made a good amount of money (for a kid), and got hands-on practice running a "business." As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Business Career, as well as in the Salaryperson Career. (Snowy Escape)
As a Child, this Sim was such a ham! They wanted everyone to watch them, and they loved to entertain. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Entertainer Career.
As a Child, this Sim loved dolls and infants! They spent time really taking care of them and playing caretaker. As an Adult, they'll build relationships with Infants and Toddlers more easily.

As a Child, this Sim was very interested in science! They studied the world around them and did scientific experiments. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Astronaut and Scientist Careers. They'll also perform better when working as an Engineer. (Discover University)
As a Child, this Sim started their own collection and had dreams of expanding it in the future! As an Adult, they'll have a better chance at winning collectibles from Buddy Scoop, the Collector Kid.

As a Child, this Sim really wanted to save the planet and took their first steps in doing so! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Civil Designer Career, as well as in the Conservationist Career. (Island Living)

As a Child, this Sim experienced Grief after a Death and had to work their way through it. It was hard work, but they came out with a new perspective on life. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Undertaker Career, and they are more resistant to acquiring a Fear of Death.
As a Child, this Sim really wanted to go on adventures and explore nature! As an Adult, they will enjoy time by themselves, and, as a result, their Social Need will decay slower.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to explore the whole ocean! Obviously, that was a little impossible to do, but they spent a lot of time in it swimming and Kayaking. As an Adult, they'll be invigorated while on the water and lose less Energy Need while on a watercraft vehicle.
As a Child, this Sim liked to swipe things and dreamed of a glamorous future in crime! an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Criminal Career.
As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time making things. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Papercraft Skill, as well as in the Painter and Art Critic Careers.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to push themselves and live dangerously, prove to the world how rough and tumble they were! As an Adult, they've acquired a resistance to food poisoning from spoiled food, won't get scared as easily, and they can better endure Extreme Heat and Cold. (Seasons) Guess that risky behavior paid off this time!
As a Child, this Sim challenged themselves to establish their own image in fashion! As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Style Influencer Career.
As a Child, this Sim wanted to be extra useful and helped out with cleaning and caring for the house! As they get older, they'll advance more quickly in Teen and Adult Part-Time Careers.
As a Child, this Sim was very interested in trying food from all over the world! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Gourmet Cooking Skill.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to see the whole world, and they traveled a lot. They learned a lot along the way and made some amazing memories. As an Adult, they'll remain Energized longer when becoming Energized.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to prove that they were independent and able to feed themselves! They learned a lot about making food along the way. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Culinary Career and the Barista and Fast Food Part-Time Careers.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to catch Rare Fish, and they did!. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Fishing Skill. They'll also advance more quickly in the Fishing Part Time Career. (Island Living)
As a Child, this Sim got kind of homesick while on a Getaway. They had to work through it and made a new friend along the way! As an Adult, they'll build relationships with Sims more quickly.
As a Child, this Sim wanted to experience true independence and challenged themselves to set out on their own away from home! As an Adult, they'll remain Confident longer when becoming Confident.

As a Child, this Sim really wanted to get good grades and be the best student they could be in school! As an Adult,they'll remain Inspired longer when becoming Inspired. They'll also advance more quickly in the Education Career and finish their University homework more quickly. (Discover University)

trait: Had a Competitive Best Imaginary Friend
description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary Friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They had a lot of challenging adventure together and also competed a lot!. As an Adult, they'll remain Confident longer when becoming Confident.

trait: Had a Creative Best Imaginary Friend
description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary Friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and spent a lot of time doing arts and crafts. As an Adult, this Sim will build creative Skills more quickly.

trait: Had a Goofball Best Imaginary Friend
description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary Friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and spent a lot of time being Goofballs together. As an Adult, their pranks will succeed more often.

trait: Had a Green Thumb as a Kid
description: As a Child, this Sim learned about plant needs and how to care for them. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Gardening Skill.

trait: Had an Evil Best Imaginary Friend
description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary Friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and did some questionable things. It was said their Imaginary Friend was kind of...Evil. As an Adult, their Mean Socials will succeed more easily.

As a Child, this Sim found a lost Swim Team Scrapbook and thought it was pretty inspirational. They spent time trying to follow in the Swim Team's footsteps. As an Adult, they'll lose less Energy Need when swimming.

As a Child, this Sim found an On Tour Scrapbook and wanted to follow in those Sims' footsteps and make their own music! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Guitar, Piano, Singing and Violin Skills. They'll also receive more tips!

As a Child, this Sim really loved Horses. They even won a Horse Competition! A total Horse Kid. As an Adult, they'll build relationships with Horses more easily and their Horses will also advance in their Horse Skills more quickly.

As a Child, this Sim found a lost Scrapbook and thought the art was amazing. They were inspired to make their own art! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Painting Skill, increase value for paintings sold, and perform better in the Freelancer Career.

As a Child, this Sim wanted to become a master Archer, just like their heroes! They actually won some competitions and learned a lot about honing in on a target. As an Adult, they'll remain Focused longer when becoming Focused.

As a Child, this Sim really wanted to learn from the past, and they decided to do so by befriending a Ghost! The ghost actually knew a lot about life and passed that knowledge onto the future generation. As an Adult, this Sim will succeed more often when interacting with other Sims.
As a Child, this Sim loved robots and tried to learn everything they could about technology! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Tech Guru and Engineering Careers.
As a Child, this Sim decided to embrace being an Enthusiast and invested in their interests! As an Adult, they'll be Bored for a shorter period of time when Bored. There's so much to think about!
As a Child, this Sim really wanted to be a successful Photographer. They even made some money doing it! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Freelance Fashion Photographer Career.
As a Child, this Sim was fascinated by death, cemeteries, and the macabre! A little creepy, but now as an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Reaper Career.

As a Child, this Sim was always chasing danger, adventure, and muddy footprints. Whether it was camping in the backyard or exploring the deepest woods they could find, there was always preparing for the wildest life. As an Adult, they will gain more Energy when replenishing the Need outdoor [sic].
As a Child, this Sim was all about structure, self-control, and discipline. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Military Career.

As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time engaging with pets and learned early on how special animal friendships can be! As an Adult, they will build Friendship more quickly with animals and train pets more quickly.

As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time playing doctor and was interested in learning about health! As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Logic Skill, as well as in the Doctor career. (Get To Work)

As a Child, this Sim loved being in the water. They spent so much time in it they got wrinkled and also really good at Diving and playing around in water. . As an Adult, they'll lose less Energy Need when swimming.

trait: Ran a Club as a Kid
description: As a Child, this Sim ran their own Club and made it the best they could! As an Adult, they'll be better at Mentoring other Sims by helping them gain Skills more quickly.
As a Child, this Sim bucked against authority and rules! As an Adult, they care a little less about what others think. They will be less Embarrassed when they become Embarrassed.
As a Child, this Sim wanted to be a rugged outdoor survivalist, and they spent a lot of time outside learning about nature! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Fitness Skill.
As a Child, this Sim was always watching, listening, and secretly gathering clues. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Secret Agent Career.
As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time hanging out with their siblings. As an Adult, they will gain Friendship with their family Sims more quickly.

As a Child, this Sim took the time to invest in other Sims and really care for them. As an Adult, when they have relationships, they'll last longer—even without as much upkeep. That's the value of being thoughtful!
As a Child, this Sim tried to be the Best Friend they could be to a group of Sims! As an Adult, they'll be more successful when using Friendly Socials on other Sims.
Always Welcome Sims will act more at home when at others' residences, and the hosts won't mind at all!
Gym Rats build Fun and don't lose Hygiene while exercising!
Observant Sims learn the traits of others just by meeting them.
Speed Cleaners tidy up much faster!
Great Storytellers always succeed at telling bigger and better stories!
Sims with Heat Acclimation aren't affected as much by hot weather, but can still feel the effects.
Sims with Cold Acclimation aren't affected as much by chilly weather, but can still feel the effects.
Waterproof Sims do not get wet in the rain.
Inspired Explorers have an easier time building relationships and skills while outside their home neighborhood.

Super Mentors draw on their experience as well as innovative teaching techniques to make their skill mentoring even more efficient than normal. They also earn more Simoleons with Paid Mentoring. Mentoring interactions become available at level 5 of certain skills.
Morning Sims build extra skill in the morning.
Night Owls build extra skill at night.
Speed Readers read books faster than your average Sim.
Storm Chaser Sims love stormy weather and thrive in terrifying conditions.
All single use service requests are free.
Marketable Sims sell items they've crafted for more Simoleons!
Stoves and Grills Masters have a chance to create impeccable quality consumables that use stoves and grills!
Creative Visionaries have a higher chance of painting and writing masterworks.
Entrepreneurial Sims are more likely to get promoted in their Career.
A Frugal Sim's household has reduced bills. (by 25% to be exact)
Independent Sims' Social Need decays slower. (decay rate x0.5)
Shameless Sims will never get Embarrassed!
Sims with a Steel Bladder rarely have to pay attention to their Bladder Need.
Incredibly Friendly Sims are immediately liked when met with a nice introduction.
Heatproof Sims aren't negatively affected by hot temperatures and enjoy the heat.
Iceproof Sims aren't negatively affected by cold temperatures and enjoy the cold.
Beguiling Sims can put anyone in a flirty mood with just one look.
Antiseptic Sims' Hygiene Need decays much slower. (decay and drain rate x0.5)
Carefree Sims will never get Tense.
Sims with Connections start all Careers several levels ahead! (i.e. at level 4 where applicable)
Fertile Sims have an easier time when trying for a baby, and a higher chance of twins or triplets.
